Name: Lazy Farmer
Author: soda5cm
Description:
[size=5][b]Lazy Farmer[/b][/size]

Tired of clicking every single crop, tree and rock? [b]Select an area with the mouse and your farmer does the routine work by himself[/b] — he walks there, picks the right tool and gets the job done.

[b]Available in English and Russian.[/b]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]Watering (key K)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Hold the left mouse button and drag a rectangle over your fields — the farmer walks around and waters them on his own.[/*]
[*][b]Only crops that actually need water[/b] are watered: empty tilled soil and already watered tiles are skipped, so no energy is wasted (empty soil can be enabled in the settings). Garden pots are watered too.[/*]
[*][b]Upgraded watering cans are used properly[/b]: the farmer charges the can (3, 5, 9 tiles, 5x5 with the Reaching enchantment) and picks the spot and direction that cover the most dry crops. A bigger charge is only used when it is worth the energy.[/*]
[*][b]When the can runs dry, he walks to the nearest water[/b] (pond, river, well...), refills it and continues.[/*]
[*]Crops you can't walk through (hops, grapes, green beans on a trellis) are watered from the side.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Chopping (key L)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Trees in the selected area are chopped down, stumps are removed.[/*]
[*][b]Fruit trees are never touched[/b], and [b]trees with a tapper are skipped[/b].[/*]
[*]Also clears [b]twigs[/b], [b]large stumps[/b] (copper axe or better) and [b]large logs that give hardwood[/b] (steel axe or better).[/*]
[*]Saplings are skipped by default (can be enabled).[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Stones (key P)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Breaks stones in the selected area — on the farm and in the mines.[/*]
[*][b]Ore and gem nodes[/b] too: copper, iron, gold, iridium, radioactive, gems, mystic stones, bone and volcano nodes.[/*]
[*][b]Boulders[/b] (steel pickaxe or better) and [b]meteorites[/b] (gold pickaxe or better).[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Smart and safe[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Uses the game's own pathfinding: the farmer walks around fences, trees, buildings and water. Unreachable targets are marked red and skipped.[/*]
[*]Stops automatically when energy is low (configurable), so you never pass out.[/*]
[*]Take control any time: moving, using a tool or pressing the key again stops the job.[/*]
[*]Targets are highlighted while selecting and while working (blue — water, green — wood, orange — stones).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Controls & config[/b][/size]
Action — Default key
Water an area — K
Chop an area — L
Break stones in an area — P
Cancel selection — Right click / Esc

All keys and options can be changed in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional) or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]: water empty soil, chop saplings, remove stumps, energy limit, target highlight.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Works in single-player and multiplayer. The mod only controls the player who has it installed — every player who wants a lazy farmer needs the mod.

Bugs or ideas? Leave a comment!

Also check out my other mod: [b]Bundle Highlighter & Item Encyclopedia[/b].
